intent: A set of related items in a DropdownMenu, labelled for assistive technology by the DropdownMenuLabel inside it.
typical_uses: A captioned section of a menu, such as the account entries under the user's name

dont_use_when.situation: A set of mutually exclusive options of which one is chosen
A visual break between items with no caption

invariants.text: The group renders `role="group"` and takes its accessible name from the DropdownMenuLabel inside it, through `aria-labelledby`, unless the caller passes its own `aria-labelledby`; a group with neither has no name.
dropdown-menu.module.css gives the group no class; it adds no spacing or divider around its items.

children.states: children is the group's label and rows
children.because: `React.ReactNode` is a union of elements, strings, numbers, fragments and more; the compiler emits one JSON type per property.

render.states: render replaces the rendered element with one the caller supplies
render.because: Base UI's render prop takes an element or a function of the group's own state, so its type is a union of a React element and a callback - the compiler emits one JSON type per property.

style.states: style accepts a function of the group's state as well as a plain style object
style.because: Base UI widens React's `CSSProperties` to `CSSProperties | ((state) => CSSProperties)` so a caller can style off the primitive's own state (an empty object for a group). The compiler emits one JSON type per property, so nothing is asserted; the kit's own styling goes through dropdown-menu.module.css, not through this.

good.title: A captioned group of account entries

bad.title: Radio items grouped by a plain group
bad.why: A radio item reads its selection from the DropdownMenuRadioGroup around it and the primitive throws when there is none; a plain group holds no value.

render.description: TS: ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | ComponentRenderFn<HTMLProps, MenuGroupState> | undefined. The compiler emits one JSON type per property, so nothing is asserted; the kit's own styling goes through dropdown-menu.module.css, not through this.
